Stillwater

A daily rhythm of Scripture, prayer, and reflection.

A daily rhythm

The Today screen puts a rotating verse and a short devotional alongside the day’s reading, prayer, and memory practice.

Read Scripture
Follow a seven-reading plan in the King James Version and save verses to revisit.
Make time to pray
Keep a list of prayer requests and use a guided session to pray through them.
Practice verse recall
Fill in missing words from saved verses, then reveal the passage to check your recall.
Keep a gratitude journal
Write down what you’re thankful for and return to earlier entries.

Project details

Languages
English and Japanese, including Japanese devotionals and original Japanese renderings of the bundled passages.
Storage
Prayer requests, journal entries, saved verses, and progress live on the device. Stillwater requires no account.
Technology
Built with Flutter.
